cases.title: CT Technologist (NYC) - $10,000 bonus for new hires!
cases.text: About Us: The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe. Exciting Opportunity at MSK! Seeking a CT Technologist to join our MITS team. This site delivers MSK’s world‑class cancer care in a setting thoughtfully designed to support patients and their families. If you’re passionate about high-quality imaging and patient-centered care, we invite you to join our exceptional radiology team! Role Overview: Perform a variety of CT imaging procedures in support of Nuclear Medicine and PET/CT procedures on patients of all age groups with minimal supervision. Operate CT equipment on hybrid imaging scanners (PET/CT and SPECT/CT) and associated equipment safely, in accordance with established policies and procedures. Explain imaging procedures to patients and monitor patient safety and comfort throughout exams. Administer contrast media (IV and/or oral) following established protocols. Conduct imaging in compliance with departmental protocols and quality standards. Accurately enter documentation into all MSK and Radiology systems. Support general radiology procedures as needed. Key Qualifications: Associate’s degree / Certified Vocational Training or Graduate from a 2-year AMA-approved Radiologic Technology program. ARRT certification in Radiography and Computed Tomography (CT). Minimum of 2 years of CT experience preferred, including experience with GE and Siemens imaging systems. New York Department of Health License in Diagnostic Radiography. IV Certification required. Core Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated, results-oriented, and adaptable. Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. Exceptional attention to detail. Collaborative, team-oriented approach to patient care. Additional Information: Location: Schwartz Building 1250 First Avenue, between 67th & 68th Streets, New York, NY Schedule: M-Fri 9a-5pm but hours can vary. Reporting to the Supervisor, Diagnostic Radiology $10,000 Sign-On Bonus for New Hires plus 10% weekend differential! cases.title: Cytopathologist
cases.text: About Us: The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe. NEW YORK, NEW YORK (USA). Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) is seeking an AP- or AP/CP-board-certified pathologist to join its Cytology Service. Candidates must have completed fellowship training in Cytopathology and be eligible for medical licensure in New York and New Jersey. Substantial experience performing ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration (FNA) biopsies is required. The Cytology Service at MSK comprises 14 pathologists supported by a large, dedicated team of allied health professionals and state-of-the-art diagnostic infrastructure, including immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, cytogenetics, molecular pathology, and digital pathology. The Service also supports an ACGME-accredited Cytopathology Fellowship Program with four fellowship positions per year. The successful candidate will provide expert diagnostic services across the full spectrum of cytopathology and will staff MSK’s ultrasound-guided FNA biopsy clinics, with an active role in performing and interpreting FNA procedures. The position offers extensive opportunities to collaborate with MSK’s multidisciplinary disease management teams in patient care and translational research, as well as to participate in the education and mentorship of fellows, residents, and other trainees. We are particularly interested in candidates who combine strong diagnostic expertise in cytopathology with substantial hands-on experience in ultrasound-guided FNA and who are committed to advancing cytologic diagnosis, multidisciplinary cancer care, education, and translational research. MSKCC offers a competitive compensation package with exceptional benefits, commensurate with experience and accomplishments. MSK provides world-class imaging services across New York City and multiple regional Imaging Centers of Excellence throughout New York and New Jersey.
